results.title: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk reports 44% revenue growth but posts larger loss and negative equity in H1 2026
results.body: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk (CASH) posted a net loss of Rp39.32 billion for the first half of 2026 despite a 44.68% year‑on‑year increase in revenue to Rp84.68 billion. Gross profit rose 21.5% to Rp19.12 billion, but higher general and administrative expenses, a Rp1.88 billion impairment on receivables, and rising financial costs drove operating loss up 67.2% to Rp16.95 billion. On the balance sheet, total assets fell 7.78% to Rp192.87 billion while liabilities grew 9.97% to Rp230.49 billion, resulting in negative equity of Rp37.61 billion. The company's shares closed slightly higher at 246, contributing to a year‑to‑date gain of 138.83%.
